security_audit.summary: Confirmed two setup command risks and one screen/audio capture risk. The remaining alerts are Markdown filenames, static project links, or ordinary instrument controls, and no prompt injection text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running npx, npm install, or npm run check. Prefer pinned local scripts and document expected package sources.
Require explicit consent before recording. Capture only the browser window when possible, and warn users not to record private content.

content.value_statement: Electronic music demos need repeatable performance steps across browser controls, MIDI, and recording. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through setup, scene design, playback, and capture.
actual_capabilities: Guides serving the project and opening the browser instrument.
Explains audio enablement, volume setup, and AudioContext troubleshooting.
Maps scenes, snapshots, sliders, rotation controls, and timbre controls.
Describes pointer, touch, motion, MIDI, tempo, and groove workflows.
Outlines recording steps, performance notes, and QA diagnostic capture.
limitations: Requires the Orthonotone repository and referenced instrument files.
Depends on browser WebAudio support and optional MIDI permissions.
Does not include a standalone synthesizer or recording tool.
Setup commands may install or run project dependencies after approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare a live browser demo
use_cases.description: Set up the instrument, enable audio, select scenes, and rehearse reliable controls before presenting.

use_cases.title: Document a soundscape workflow
use_cases.description: Capture snapshots, slider choices, tempo settings, and performance notes for repeatable collaboration.

use_cases.title: Check instrument regressions
use_cases.description: Use the optional Playwright harness and QA report guidance to compare performance behavior after changes.

prompt_templates.title: Start the instrument
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Orthonotone performance skill. Walk me through serving the project, opening the instrument, enabling audio, and selecting a first scene.

prompt_templates.title: Shape a scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a calm Orthonotone scene. Choose starting controls, adjust timbre and rotation settings, and save a named snapshot.

prompt_templates.title: Build a setlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a three-part Orthonotone performance. Include snapshot order, gesture ideas, tempo settings, and notes to archive after recording.

prompt_templates.title: Capture and verify a session
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide an Orthonotone recording session with consent checks, browser-only capture, MIDI or tempo verification, and QA diagnostics after the take.

output_examples.input: I need a quick Orthonotone demo with audio and visuals.
output_examples.output: Start the local server, open the instrument page, enable audio, choose Prismatic Bloom, set a safe volume, and test one snapshot transition.

output_examples.input: Help me make a repeatable ambient scene.
output: Select a neutral scene and lower rotation speeds.
Increase shell width and reduce glitch intensity.
Save the state as a named snapshot and record the key settings.

output_examples.output: Check browser audio permission, confirm Master Volume is above zero, verify AudioContext is running, and ensure the recorder captures browser audio.

best_practices: Ask for consent before running setup commands or recording audio and video.
Save named snapshots before improvising so scenes remain repeatable.
Archive tempo, MIDI, and QA notes with each recorded session.
anti_patterns: Do not run dependency commands in an untrusted checkout without approval.
Do not record the full desktop when a browser window capture is enough.
Do not rely on memory for performance settings after a session.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It guides use of the Orthonotone browser instrument, including scenes, sliders, gestures, MIDI, tempo, recording, and troubleshooting.

faq.question: Does it generate audio by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides the existing Orthonotone MVP and browser WebAudio controls.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require command execution?
faq.answer: Some setup paths use npx, npm install, or npm run check. Confirm commands before running them.

faq.question: Can it help with MIDI performances?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains MIDI bridge setup, tempo sync, and related status checks.

faq.question: Is screen recording automatic?
faq.answer: No. Recording requires a separate recorder and explicit user consent.
